scripts.dev:electron: wait-on http-get://localhost:5173 file:dist-electron/main.js file:dist-electron/preload.js && cross-env VITE_DEV_SERVER_URL=http://localhost:5173 node ./scripts/run-electron.cjs
scripts.build: npm run ensure:electron:cjs && tsc -b && vite build
scripts.start: npm run ensure:electron:cjs && cross-env NODE_ENV=production node ./scripts/run-electron.cjs
scripts.package: npm run build && npx electron-builder --publish never
scripts.package:win: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win --publish never
scripts.package:portable: npm run build && npx electron-builder --win portable --publish never
